messages:
Sophie: Quick thread  saved-view preview question for console analytics. If a user saves a view scoped to a route that currently has a pinned model, do we treat the saved view as 'locking' the pin (so restore will force that model) or merely 'suggest' the model in the preview? Need a decision before Friday so we can ship the preview in the rollout.

Jamal: Leaning lock-by-default for route+model saves. In practice people expect saved views to capture the end state. For API I'd add `pinned_models` array to the savedview resource and a `locked` bool in preview. Backcompat: default to false if missing.

Maria Chen: Locking makes sense from a telemetry/QA POV. Also want the preview to show a few small telemetry cues: `sample_rate`, `24h_token_burn`, and an estimated token delta if the model is different. That way teams can see cost impact before applying.

Oliver: UI constraint: we have limited space in the savedview preview card. Suggest a compact row: [ModelChip] [cost delta badge] [info icon]. Info hover opens flyout with sample rate, last 24h burn, and pin provenance. Keeps the main surface clean.

Kevin (PM): Migration risk: this changes semantics for many existing savedviews that were effectively route-only. We should gate behind `console.savedview.v2` and ship a migration banner in the console with opt-in. Also prepare messaging for customers on Dedicated.

Sophie: Agreed on feature flag + migration banner. Jamal, can you keep the public API compat while adding these fields?

Jamal: Example API sketch (keeping as additive fields):

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "scope": "route|model|global",
  "route_id": "string",
  "pinned_models": ["string"],
  "preview": {
    "sample_rate": "number",
    "token_estimate": "number",
    "locked": true
  },
  "metadata": "string"
}
```

Note: the above is just a quick draft; will post a cleaned schema later. Backcompat: servers should ignore unknown fields.

Maria Chen: Please add `provenance` ideally in preview or metadata: who pinned, when, and whether it was autosuggest or user action. That reduces support noise.

Oliver: UI microcopy idea: show provenance as tiny text on hover: "pinned by Maria Chen • 2025-02-14 • suggested by Optimize". Keeps things discoverable without clutter.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `savedview-v2` toggled to staging at 2024-09-12T18:22Z :rocket:

Sophie: Action list: Jamal post API schema + migration script; Oliver build ModelChip + flyout; Maria wire telemetry endpoints & include provenance; Kevin draft rollout notes and banner text; Sophie will write RFC summarizing lock default, preview fields, FF, migration flow. Tagging #product for awareness.

Jamal: I'll follow up with a minimal migration snippet showing how to mark existing route-scoped savedviews as unlocked and surface the banner to affected users.

Maria Chen: I'll attach compact mockups to the RFC showing the chip and flyout.

Oliver: I'll prototype the chip component today and DM Sophie with screenshots.
